Kill 2 [[Stygian Underlord]]s.

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill 2 Stygian Underlords in the [[Stygian Veil]].
* *BONUS* Kill 2 Stygian Underlords in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 300 [[Lightbringer rank|Lightbringer Points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
See [[Breaching the Stygian Veil]].
